description.value: Ugly Duckling is an award-winning innovative tasting-menu restaurant that opened in February 2023 in the heart of Victoria's historic Chinatown. It was named Victoria's Best New Restaurant by YAM Magazine and long-listed among Canada's Best New Restaurants by Air Canada's En Route Magazine. The kitchen produces entirely handcrafted, seasonally rotating dishes sourced from Vancouver Island's small farms and wild ingredients.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the address (543 Fisgard St., Victoria, BC V8W 1R3), phone ((250)978-0915), and operating status. The site describes Ugly Duckling as an innovative tasting-menu restaurant in Victoria's Chinatown, open since February 2023, with no mention of bike parking, washrooms, takeout packaging, or cyclist-specific amenities. A name discrepancy exists: OSM records 'Ugly Duckling Dining & Provisions' while the website consistently uses 'Ugly Duckling Restaurant'; the OSM cuisine tag 'chinese' also appears inconsistent with the website's description of a seasonal Vancouver Island tasting menu.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records 'Ugly Duckling Dining & Provisions' but the website and domain consistently use 'Ugly Duckling Restaurant'. OSM name may be outdated or incorrect.

OSM cuisine tag is 'chinese', but the website describes a seasonal Vancouver Island tasting menu with no reference to Chinese cuisine; the restaurant is located in Chinatown but does not appear to serve Chinese food.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible restaurant confirmed via active website and matching contact details. A notable dining destination in Victoria's Chinatown of clear interest to touring cyclists.
